Package models.academic

Class Attendance

java.lang.Object
models.academic.Attendance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Attendance extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an attendance record for a student in a specific lesson. Tracks whether the student was present or absent on a given date.
